english.title: Fail to return original driving licence on issue of duplicate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been issued with a duplicate driving licence in accordance with regulation 21 of the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations 1999, failed, on the original licence being found,

(A)_[to return that original licence]_
(B)_[to, on becoming aware that it had been found, take all reasonable steps to take possession of it and, if successful, return it as soon as may be]_

to the Secretary of State
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 21(3) of the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations 1999 and section 91 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
